title: Flappy Flamingo: Albania's Flamingo Revolution
story: You are an Albanian flamingo, and someone wants to build a luxury resort on your lagoon. The cranes are already going up. Glide through them under the double-headed eagle: the whole country has named its protest movement after you.
inspiration: Albania's 'Flamingo Revolution': protests that began over a luxury coastal resort on protected flamingo habitat (linked to Jared Kushner) escalated again in Tirana on 7 Nov 2026 with water cannons and calls for PM Edi Rama to resign (X Trending 2119125832195322015, 7 Nov 2026; background 2113390836243386548, 24 Oct 2026). Archetype: Moon Gravity — gravity 0.09, jump 3.5 (apex ~68px), slow 2.5 scroll: a flamingo glide. Bird = greater flamingo in flight (Commons 'Phoenicopterus roseus flight (Walvis bay)'), cut with rembg; pillar = tower crane mast colour-keyed from Commons 'Red Tower Crane - Knoxville' (recoloured toward construction yellow); animated background = waving, dimmed Flag of Albania (Commons SVG) as a 12-frame GIF.
